title: steiremis heterophylla
intro: Steiremis heterophylla, commonly known as Stevia, is a plant native to South America, specifically in the tropical and subtropical regions. Stevia is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing blood sugar levels, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in weight management due to its natural sweetening properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. Stevia's bioactive constituents include stevioside and rebaudioside, which are glycosides responsible for its sweetness and medicinal properties.
